input: Write a business email in formal Japanese

gold.taskTitle: Write a Formal Business Email in Japanese
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to compose a formal business email written in Japanese.

questions.title: Who is the recipient of this email?
questions.description: Identify the recipient, such as a client, business partner, supplier, or colleague.

questions.title: What is the main purpose or subject of the email?
questions.description: Clarify the core message, such as making a request, sending an apology, following up, introducing yourself, or confirming a meeting.

questions.title: What is your relationship with the recipient?
questions.description: Determine whether this is a first contact, an ongoing business relationship, or a senior/junior dynamic that affects the level of formality.

questions.title: What key information or details must the email include?
questions.description: Gather specific facts, dates, figures, names, or requests that must appear in the email body.

questions.title: What tone or level of keigo is required?
questions.description: Clarify whether the email should use sonkeigo, kenjougo, or standard teineigo based on the situation and recipient.

questions.title: What is the desired length or structure of the email?
questions.description: Find out if the user wants a brief note, a full structured email with opening and closing lines, or a specific format.

questions.title: Do you need a translation or explanation alongside the Japanese?
questions.description: Determine whether the user wants an English translation, grammar notes, or vocabulary explanations provided with the email.
